description: Historical football manager data foundation connected to History Go unlocks.
notes: Formations are historical tactical systems, not just numeric shapes.
Old formations are not bad by default; they require correct player types and principles.
Players are strong by default; tactical misuse creates negative performance.
Unlocks should connect to History Go places, clubs, stadiums, players and staff.
This module is additive and self-contained; it does not replace the existing data/football_*.json unlock-loop dataset.
Schema namespace 'history-go.hg-football.*' is intentional for this module and runs alongside the existing 'historygo-football-manager.*' files.
